CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
